metadata.title: zERC20 Privacy Token Protocol - Remaining Properties Audit Checklist (Stage 2 - Batch 2)
metadata.description: Partial checklist for non-boundary properties. This batch covers verifier operations, teleport flow, and hub root reception.

checklist.title: Verify STATE-TRANSFER-REJECTED-VALUE-TOO-LARGE is reached only when value > 2^248-1
checklist.description: Verify that transfers are rejected with ValueTooLarge error only when the resulting balance would exceed the BN254 field constraint, and valid transfers are never incorrectly rejected.
detection_procedure: 1. Locate the MAX_VALUE constant in zERC20.sol
4. Test transfer with value exactly at MAX_VALUE boundary
5. Confirm revert message matches expected error

executable_checks.assertion: Transfer at MAX_VALUE succeeds, transfer at MAX_VALUE+1 fails
Uses strict > comparison, not >=

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-NODE-021-STATE-TRANSFER-REJECTED-VALUE-TOO-LARGE -> Node STATE-TRANSFER-REJECTED-VALUE-TOO-LARGE. Ensures BN254 constraint rejection is precise.

checklist.title: Verify Verifier contract is stateless and always ready for operations
checklist.description: Verify that the Verifier contract has no blocking state that could prevent processing of hash chain reservations or proof submissions.
detection_procedure: 2. Identify any locking or pausing mechanisms
3. Verify no operation sets a flag that blocks subsequent calls
4. Confirm emergency mode has recovery path

executable_checks.assertion: No state variables that could block operations
Multiple operations can execute in same block

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-NODE-022-STATE-VERIFIER-IDLE -> Node STATE-VERIFIER-IDLE. Verifier availability is critical for protocol liveness.

checklist.title: Verify hash chain checkpoint is immutable once reserved
checklist.description: Verify that once a hash chain checkpoint is stored in reservedHashChains mapping, it cannot be modified or overwritten.
detection_procedure: 1. Locate reservedHashChains mapping in Verifier contract
2. Search for all write operations to this mapping
3. Verify reservation only succeeds if slot is empty
4. Confirm no function allows overwriting existing entries
5. Check for any admin bypass mechanisms

executable_checks.assertion: Only one write location with empty slot check
Second reservation at same index reverts

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-NODE-023-ACTION-VERIFIER-RESERVE-HASH-CHAIN -> Node ACTION-VERIFIER-RESERVE-HASH-CHAIN. Hash chain immutability prevents proof replay attacks.

checklist.title: Verify STATE-HASH-CHAIN-RESERVED implies checkpoint stored in mapping
checklist.description: Verify that the HashChainReserved event is only emitted after successful storage of the checkpoint in the reservedHashChains mapping.
detection_procedure: 2. Verify storage write precedes event emission
3. Confirm no path emits event without storage
5. Verify indexed event parameters match stored data

executable_checks.assertion: Storage write before event emission
Event data matches mapping contents

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-NODE-024-STATE-HASH-CHAIN-RESERVED -> Node STATE-HASH-CHAIN-RESERVED. Event-state consistency critical for indexer correctness.

checklist.title: Verify transfer root proof requires prior hash chain reservation
checklist.description: Verify that proveTransferRoot function validates existence of hash chain reservation at the target index before accepting proof submission.
detection_procedure: 3. Verify check happens before proof verification
4. Confirm revert if reservation doesn't exist

executable_checks.assertion: Proof submission reverts if no reservation exists
Reservation check uses correct comparison

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-NODE-025-STATE-AWAITING-TRANSFER-ROOT-PROOF -> Node STATE-AWAITING-TRANSFER-ROOT-PROOF. CRITICAL: Prevents unbound proof submissions.

checklist.title: Verify Nova proof validation uses correct public inputs from reserved checkpoint
checklist.description: Verify that the Nova/Groth16 proof verification invokes IRootDecider.verifyOpaqueNovaProof with public inputs derived from the reserved hash chain checkpoint.
detection_procedure: 3. Verify reserved hash chain checkpoint is included
4. Confirm transfer root is included in public inputs
5. Verify no substitution or omission of inputs

executable_checks.assertion: Public inputs include: reserved checkpoint, transfer root, chain ID
Proof with mismatched public inputs rejected

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-NODE-026-ACTION-VERIFIER-VALIDATE-NOVA-PROOF -> Node ACTION-VERIFIER-VALIDATE-NOVA-PROOF. CRITICAL: ZKP soundness foundation.

checklist.title: Verify STATE-TRANSFER-ROOT-PROVED only reachable after valid ZKP verification
checklist.description: Verify that transfer root storage in provedTransferRoots mapping only occurs after successful completion of ZKP verification, with no bypass paths.
detection_procedure: 2. Trace all code paths to this write
3. Verify every path includes verifyOpaqueNovaProof call
4. Confirm require statement guards the storage
5. Check for any admin override functions

executable_checks.assertion: All paths to storage include proof verification
Invalid proof prevents root storage

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-NODE-027-STATE-TRANSFER-ROOT-PROVED -> Node STATE-TRANSFER-ROOT-PROVED. CRITICAL: Cryptographic binding of roots to proofs.

checklist.title: Verify emergency state only triggered by divergent valid proofs
checklist.description: Verify that emergency mode is triggered only when two valid proofs produce different transfer roots for the same hash chain index, indicating a potential ZK system bug.
detection_procedure: 2. Verify both proofs must pass verification
3. Confirm root comparison is for same index
4. Check emergency cannot be triggered by single proof

executable_checks.assertion: Requires: existing root + new valid proof + roots differ
Emergency requires divergent valid proofs

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-NODE-028-STATE-EMERGENCY-TRIGGERED -> Node STATE-EMERGENCY-TRIGGERED. Emergency detection for ZK soundness violations.

checklist.title: Verify teleport processing requires valid proof data submission
checklist.description: Verify that teleport function requires non-empty proof parameter and that empty or malformed proofs are rejected before processing.
detection_procedure: 2. Check proof parameter validation at entry
3. Verify proof bytes length is checked

executable_checks.assertion: Empty proof bytes rejected
Proof length validated before verification call

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-NODE-029-STATE-AWAITING-TELEPORT-PROOF -> Node STATE-AWAITING-TELEPORT-PROOF. Prevents teleport without proof submission.

checklist.title: Verify root reference validation checks both proved and global root mappings
checklist.description: Verify that teleport root reference validation checks existence in provedTransferRoots OR globalTransferRoots before proceeding with withdrawal verification.
detection_procedure: 1. Locate root reference check in teleport flow
4. Confirm revert with RootNotFound if absent from both
5. Test with reference not in either mapping

executable_checks.assertion: Teleport reverts if root not in proved or global mappings
Checks both provedTransferRoots and globalTransferRoots

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-NODE-030-ACTION-VERIFIER-VALIDATE-ROOT-REFERENCE -> Node ACTION-VERIFIER-VALIDATE-ROOT-REFERENCE. CRITICAL: Prevents teleport against unproved roots.

checklist.title: Verify recipient hash binds proof to msg.sender
checklist.description: Verify that the withdrawal proof public inputs include a recipient hash derived from GeneralRecipient(chain_id, msg.sender, tweak), preventing proof theft.
detection_procedure: 1. Locate recipient hash computation in teleport flow
3. Confirm msg.sender is bound to recipient address
4. Verify tweak is included for domain separation
5. Confirm hash is included in proof public inputs

executable_checks.assertion: Proof valid for address A rejected when called by address B

executable_checks.command: Trace GeneralRecipient hash to public inputs
executable_checks.assertion: Recipient hash cryptographically binds proof to caller

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-NODE-031-ACTION-VERIFIER-VALIDATE-RECIPIENT-HASH -> Node ACTION-VERIFIER-VALIDATE-RECIPIENT-HASH. CRITICAL: Prevents front-running/proof theft.

checklist.title: Verify monotonicity check prevents double-spend
checklist.description: Verify that the monotonicity check enforces newTotalTeleported > totalTeleported[recipient] using strict inequality, preventing any value from being claimed twice.
detection_procedure: 3. Confirm check happens before token minting

executable_checks.assertion: Same proof cannot be used twice
Uses strict > comparison

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-NODE-032-ACTION-VERIFIER-CHECK-MONOTONICITY -> Node ACTION-VERIFIER-CHECK-MONOTONICITY. CRITICAL: Core double-spend prevention mechanism.

checklist.title: Verify withdrawal proof uses Groth16 verification with correct inputs
checklist.description: Verify that withdrawal claim proof verification invokes the Groth16 verifier with correctly constructed public inputs including transfer root, recipient hash, and amounts.

executable_checks.assertion: Invalid/forged proof rejected
Implements standard Groth16 verification

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-NODE-033-ACTION-VERIFIER-VALIDATE-WITHDRAWAL-PROOF -> Node ACTION-VERIFIER-VALIDATE-WITHDRAWAL-PROOF. CRITICAL: 128-bit ZKP soundness.

checklist.title: Verify teleport delta calculation is correct
checklist.description: Verify that zERC20.teleport() is called with delta = newTotalTeleported - totalTeleported[recipient], ensuring correct token minting amount.
detection_procedure: 4. Confirm computation is atomic with storage update

executable_checks.assertion: Minted amount equals newTotal - oldTotal
delta = newTotalTeleported - totalTeleported[recipientHash]

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-NODE-034-ACTION-VERIFIER-CALL-TELEPORT -> Node ACTION-VERIFIER-CALL-TELEPORT. CRITICAL: Correct minting amount.

checklist.title: Verify STATE-TELEPORT-COMPLETE requires all validations passed
checklist.description: Verify that teleport completion state is only reached after successful proof verification, monotonicity check, and correct token minting.
detection_procedure: 1. Trace all paths to teleport completion

executable_checks.assertion: Successful teleport requires all checks passed
No paths bypass validation

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-NODE-035-STATE-TELEPORT-COMPLETE -> Node STATE-TELEPORT-COMPLETE. Teleport completion invariant.

checklist.title: Verify teleport rejection provides proper error indication
checklist.description: Verify that teleport failures revert with appropriate error codes indicating which validation step failed (root, recipient, monotonicity, or proof).
detection_procedure: 1. Identify all revert paths in teleport flow
2. Verify each has distinct error code

executable_checks.assertion: Each failure mode has unique error

executable_checks.command: Review revert statements in teleport path
executable_checks.assertion: All failures use revert with custom error

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-NODE-036-STATE-TELEPORT-REJECTED -> Node STATE-TELEPORT-REJECTED. Error clarity aids debugging.

checklist.title: Verify root relay uses correct LayerZero encoding and destination
checklist.description: Verify that proved transfer root is sent to Hub via LayerZero with correct payload encoding and configured Hub EID destination.
detection_procedure: 2. Verify Hub EID is correctly configured
4. Verify root data is included in payload

executable_checks.assertion: Payload encodes root and metadata correctly
Destination EID matches Hub configuration

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-NODE-037-ACTION-VERIFIER-RELAY-ROOT -> Node ACTION-VERIFIER-RELAY-ROOT. Cross-chain root relay integrity.

checklist.title: Verify STATE-ROOT-RELAYED implies LayerZero message submitted
checklist.description: Verify that the root relayed state is only reached after successful _lzSend call submission, with LayerZero handling subsequent delivery.
detection_procedure: 1. Trace code path to RootRelayed event
4. Verify event parameters match sent data

executable_checks.assertion: Event emitted only after successful _lzSend
Failures revert, no silent failures

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-NODE-038-STATE-ROOT-RELAYED -> Node STATE-ROOT-RELAYED. LayerZero message submission state.

checklist.title: Verify Hub contract is stateless and always ready for operations
checklist.description: Verify that the Hub contract has no blocking state preventing reception of roots or triggering of broadcasts.
detection_procedure: 3. Verify no operation blocks subsequent calls

executable_checks.assertion: No blocking state variables
Multiple roots can be received concurrently

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-NODE-039-STATE-HUB-IDLE -> Node STATE-HUB-IDLE. Hub availability is critical for aggregation.

checklist.title: Verify Hub validates source EID against registered Verifier list
checklist.description: Verify that Hub _lzReceive implementation checks source EID against registered peer Verifiers and rejects messages from unauthorized sources.
detection_procedure: 3. Verify check happens before message processing

executable_checks.assertion: Message from non-registered EID rejected
Validates source against peers mapping

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-NODE-040-ACTION-HUB-RECEIVE-ROOT -> Node ACTION-HUB-RECEIVE-ROOT. CRITICAL: Source EID validation prevents rogue root injection.
